## What changed?

Describe the correction, source, repository addition, or tooling change.

## Evidence

Link every new or changed factual claim to a public source.

## Checklist

- [ ] I changed source data or tooling, not generated pages by hand.
- [ ] `python tools/build.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes.
- [ ] English and Turkish outputs remain aligned where the change affects both.
- [ ] I did not copy third-party content into the repository; I linked it and added an assessment.
